market.worldSizeUSD_B_range: Sugar processing equipment: ~$5.2B (2024) to ~$8.7B by 2033 (~6.1%/yr). Sugar crystallization equipment sub-segment specifically (core to this segment's product line): ~$1.5B (2024) to ~$2.8B by 2033 (~7.5%/yr). Global sugar mill machinery alone: ~$2.62B (2024).

market.domesticSlice: India: achieved its E20 (20% ethanol blending) target in 2025, five years ahead of the original 2030 deadline; ethanol production capacity grew from <2B litres (2014) to ~20B litres; government targets E27 by 2030. A December 2025 government directive curtailed sugarcane-juice/syrup-based ethanol diversion over domestic sugar-availability concerns, creating near-term uncertainty for sugar-linked distillery capex specifically.
